lines.say: Your dreams now have ads. Ad-free dreams cost five dollars a night.
You dream about the sea. Then a man sells you a sofa. For ten minutes.
You pay to skip. Five dollars a night. Your balance melts.
You can't pay any more. The ads come back. You get used to them.
Then one night, an ad starts with your late mom’s voice. Buy now, sweetheart.
Would you pay for ad-free dreams? Write it in the comments.
